☢️ HOW TO PLAY
SURVIVE THE WASTELAND
🕹️Move - drag anywhere on the left to steer. You auto-fire at the nearest enemy.
💨Dash - tap the button (bottom-right) for a quick i-framed dodge.
🚪Clear rooms - kill everything to open the doors. Check the map (top-right) for what's left.
💀Beat the boss - every zone ends with one. Win to open the portal to the next zone.
🔥Ember - every run makes the next one stronger. Pick a biome and go.
☢️Mutations - free upgrades between rooms. Every 5th is an Elite. Some combo together.
🗝️Keys & Item Rooms - spend a key to unlock a room with a weapon + Power Core.
🕳️Secrets - feel the music shimmer and spot the cracked wall, then walk into the crack to break through. Hidden rooms hold vaults of loot.
🔬Discoveries - statuses interact: burn kills can explode, chilled foes shatter, arcs crit and freeze. Found interactions are logged forever in the Codex.
⚔️Melee - runs on a slow-recharging stamina bar. Empty bar = weak light attacks; full bar = devastating sweeps that deflect bullets.
🎲Event rooms - corrupted caches pay double, meltdown rooms race a reactor timer, gambles risk ambushes - and one merchant takes payment in blood.
🛒Shop room - spend banked scrap on upgrades. The altar trades HP for an Elite.
